review:
Dragon Gold 88 is a 10-line Asian slot set among icy mountains, with turtles, frogs and fish. Three or more scatters trigger up to 20 free spins, and two scatters nudge down, lock in place and award a respin for a chance at the third.

Before the bonus begins, you can enhance it with modifiers such as extra money symbols, more dragons, two extra spins, or starting at a higher level, much like recent Big Bass titles. The RTP of 96.71% is high. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win on the page. The scatter-nudge respin softens near misses.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
